name: Run it like a business
about: Register your name, keep money straight, train help and plan for the busy season.

lessons.title: Register your business name with CAC
lessons.intro: A registered business name helps buyers, suppliers and banks take you seriously. You can start online on the CAC portal. This lesson shows what to get ready and the steps to follow.
lessons.intro_pcm: When your business name don register, buyers, suppliers and banks go take you serious. You fit start am online for CAC portal. This lesson go show you wetin to arrange and the steps to follow.
learn: What to do with your certificate
steps: Pick two or three names
In case your first choice is already taken.
Search on the CAC portal
Check the name is available before you pay anything.
Check the current fee there
Fees change, so read it on the CAC portal, not on a flyer.
Keep your certificate safe
Save one copy on your phone and one in your email.
lessons.try: Write three names for your business and search each one on the CAC portal today.
lessons.try_pcm: Write three names for your business and search each one for CAC portal today.
checks: I wrote three name ideas
I searched them on the CAC portal
I checked the current fee there
I know where I will keep my certificate
lessons.quiz: Where should you check the current fee to register a business name?
options: A flyer shared in a WhatsApp group
A friend who registered last year
lessons.why: Fees can change, so the official CAC portal is the place to trust.

lessons.title: Keep business money and personal money apart
lessons.intro: When shop money and house money share one account, you can’t tell if you are making profit. A separate account and a simple pay-yourself rule fix that.
lessons.intro_pcm: When shop money and house money dey the same account, you no go fit know if you dey make profit. Separate account and simple rule for how you go pay yourself go solve am.
learn: What to do when you borrow from the shop
steps: Open a separate account
Ask your bank what they need for a business account.
Send all shop money there
Make it your Shopinbos payout account.
Pay yourself on a set day
A fixed amount, like ₦30,000 at the end of each month.
Write down any borrowing
If you take shop money for home, note it and pay it back.
lessons.try: Decide how much you will pay yourself each month and the day you will do it. Write it down.
lessons.try_pcm: Decide how much you go pay yourself every month and the day wey you go do am. Write am down.
checks: My shop money has its own account
My payouts go to that account
I set my monthly pay and pay day
I write down anything I borrow from the shop
lessons.quiz: You took ₦10,000 of shop money for school fees. What should you do?
options: Write it down and pay it back
Forget it, it’s all your money
lessons.why: A simple note keeps your profit numbers honest, even when life happens.

lessons.title: Simple bookkeeping on your phone
lessons.intro: Bookkeeping is just writing down money in and money out. Ten minutes a week on your phone tells you what you really made.
lessons.intro_pcm: Bookkeeping na just to write money wey enter and money wey comot. Ten minutes every week for your phone go tell you wetin you really make.
steps: Let Shopinbos record sales
Every paid order shows in Money in the app.
Note every cost
Date, what it was for and how much, in a note or spreadsheet.
Snap your receipts
Keep them in one photo album for each month.
Total it every Friday
Money in minus money out.
lessons.try: Start a costs note today and add everything you spent on the shop this week, even ₦500 for nylon.
lessons.try_pcm: Start costs note today and add everything wey you spend for the shop this week, even ₦500 for nylon.
checks: I can see my sales in the app
I have a costs note on my phone
I keep my receipts in one album
I set a Friday money check
lessons.quiz: This week your sales were ₦120,000 and your costs were ₦85,000. What did you make?
lessons.why: Profit is money in minus money out: ₦120,000 minus ₦85,000 is ₦35,000.

lessons.title: When your costs go up, check your prices
lessons.intro: Supplier prices, fuel and delivery costs change often. If your price stays the same, your profit quietly shrinks. Here is how to spot it and adjust without losing buyers.
lessons.intro_pcm: Supplier price, fuel and delivery cost dey change anyhow. If your price no change, your profit go dey reduce quietly. See how to notice am and adjust without losing your buyers.
learn: Working out your profit per item
Other ways to protect your profit
steps: Recheck your costs every month
Product, packing and any delivery you cover.
Work out profit per item
Price minus all costs, including the payment fee.
Adjust in small steps
₦500 now is easier for buyers than ₦3,000 later.
Tell your regulars first
A short, honest message before the new price starts.
lessons.try: Pick your three best sellers, check what each one costs you today, and see if your profit is still where you want it.
lessons.try_pcm: Pick your three best sellers, check how much each one dey cost you today, and see if your profit still dey where you want am.
checks: I checked today’s cost for my best sellers
I know my profit per item
I planned any price change in small steps
I will tell my regulars first
lessons.quiz: You sell a bag for ₦15,000. Your cost went from ₦9,000 to ₦10,500. How much less do you now make on each bag?
lessons.why: Every naira added to your cost comes out of your profit unless you change your price.

lessons.title: Train your helper and set their access
lessons.intro: Hiring a helper is the first step. Training them well and giving them only the access they need is what lets you rest. This lesson shows how to set up your first helper so mistakes stay small.
lessons.intro_pcm: To hire helper na first step. To train dem well and give dem only the access wey dem need, na im go make you rest. This lesson go show you how to set up your first helper so mistake no go big.
learn: Giving staff only the access they need
Checking work in the first weeks
steps: Write one page of rules
How you pack, reply to chats and confirm orders.
Add them as staff
Their own sign-in, never yours.
Give only what they need
A packer does not need payouts or bank settings.
Remove access the day they leave
Then change any passwords you shared.
lessons.try: Write your packing and reply rules on one page. Then add your helper as staff with limited access.
lessons.try_pcm: Write your packing and reply rules for one page. Then add your helper as staff with small access.
checks: I wrote my rules on one page
My helper has their own staff sign-in
They only have the access they need
I know how to remove access
lessons.quiz: Your helper only packs orders. What access should they have?
options: Only what they need to see and pack orders
lessons.why: Limited access keeps your money and settings safe, and makes mistakes easy to trace.

lessons.title: Plan stock for Black Friday, Christmas and Detty December
lessons.intro: November and December bring more buyers, but suppliers and riders get busy too. Planning stock early means you have what people want when they want it.
lessons.intro_pcm: November and December dey bring plenty buyers, but suppliers and riders go busy too. If you plan your stock early, you go get wetin people want when dem want am.
steps: Look back at last year
Which products sold most in November and December? If you are new, ask your chats what people plan to buy.
Order your winners early
Suppliers and markets like Balogun get crowded close to Christmas.
Keep dropship backups
Pick similar supplier products for when you sell out.
Set a last order date
Tell buyers the last day to order for delivery before Christmas.
lessons.try: List five products you expect to sell in December and how many of each you will need.
lessons.try_pcm: List five products wey you think say you go sell for December and how many of each one you go need.
checks: I checked what sold last season
I listed my December products
I picked dropship backups
I set a last order date for Christmas
lessons.quiz: Your best seller may run out in December. What is the safest plan?
options: Order early and add a dropship backup
lessons.why: Early stock covers the rush, and dropship products keep you selling if you run out.

name: Sell food and beauty products
about: NAFDAC basics, labels, packing and photos for food, drinks, creams and soaps.

lessons.title: NAFDAC basics for food and cosmetics
lessons.intro: If you make or sell packaged food, drinks or cosmetics, NAFDAC rules may apply to you. Many buyers and shops look for a NAFDAC number before they trust a product. This lesson explains the basics and where to check the details.
lessons.intro_pcm: If you dey make or sell packaged food, drinks or cosmetics, NAFDAC rules fit concern you. Plenty buyers and shops dey look for NAFDAC number before dem trust product. This lesson go explain the basics and where to check the full details.
learn: Which of your products it may cover
Where to check the current guidance
What to do while you prepare
steps: List your products
Mark which ones are packaged food, drinks or cosmetics.
Read NAFDAC’s current guidance
On NAFDAC’s official website or at their office, not from hearsay.
Plan before you sell widely
Products sold widely need to be registered.
Ask NAFDAC when unsure
Rules and fees change, so check with them directly.
lessons.try: List your products and mark the packaged food, drinks or cosmetics. Then find NAFDAC’s current guidance for one of them.
lessons.try_pcm: List your products and mark the packaged food, drinks or cosmetics. Then find NAFDAC current guidance for one of dem.
checks: I listed my products
I marked my food and cosmetics
I read NAFDAC’s current guidance
I know where to ask when I’m unsure
lessons.quiz: Where should you get the rules for registering your shea butter cream?
options: A seller in a WhatsApp group
lessons.why: Rules and fees can change, so go to NAFDAC directly.

lessons.title: Labels and expiry dates buyers trust
lessons.intro: A clear label answers questions before buyers ask them. It also shows you take food and skin safety seriously.
lessons.intro_pcm: Clear label dey answer question before buyers ask am. E still show say you take food and skin safety serious.
learn: Writing expiry dates people can read
steps: Name and size
What it is and how much: “Zobo drink, 50cl”.
Every ingredient
So buyers with allergies can check for themselves.
A clear expiry date
Write the month in words, like “Best before March 2027”.
Your name and contact
So buyers know who made it and how to reach you.
lessons.try: Check one product label against these four steps and fix anything that is missing.
lessons.try_pcm: Check one product label with these four steps and fix anything wey no dey there.
checks: My label shows name and size
Every ingredient is listed
The expiry date is easy to read
My name and contact are on it
lessons.quiz: A buyer with a nut allergy asks about your chin chin. What helps them most?
options: A full ingredient list on the label
lessons.why: Clear ingredients let buyers decide for themselves and save you guesswork.

lessons.title: Packaging that survives delivery and heat
lessons.intro: Drinks can leak, soups can spill and creams can melt in a hot delivery box. Packing for heat and bumps keeps your products safe until the buyer opens them.
lessons.intro_pcm: Drink fit leak, soup fit pour and cream fit melt inside hot delivery box. If you pack for heat and shaking, your products go reach buyer safe.
learn: Products that should not travel far
steps: Seal and tape every lid
Then put each jar or bottle in its own nylon.
Use a strong inner box
So jars and bottles don’t knock each other.
Keep heat-sensitive items cool
Send them in the morning and never leave parcels in the sun.
Test one parcel
Shake it, leave it somewhere warm for an hour, then open it.
lessons.try: Pack one product the way you normally do. Shake it, leave it somewhere warm for an hour, then check it.
lessons.try_pcm: Pack one product the way wey you dey always pack. Shake am, leave am for hot place for one hour, then check am.
checks: Every lid is sealed and taped
Each jar or bottle has its own nylon
I send heat-sensitive items in the morning
I tested one parcel
lessons.quiz: Your body butter arrived melted in Abuja. What should you change first?
options: Send it in the afternoon sun
Seal it well, send it in the morning and keep it out of the sun
lessons.why: Heat is the problem, so cut the time your parcel spends in it.

lessons.title: Photos for food and beauty products
lessons.intro: With food and beauty, buyers want to see texture, size and colour on real skin. These photos answer their questions and cut down complaints.
lessons.intro_pcm: For food and beauty, buyers wan see texture, size and how colour be for real skin. These photos go answer their question and reduce complain.
learn: Showing shades on different skin tones
steps: Show the texture
Cream on a finger, soup in a spoon, a slice of cake.
Show the real size
Next to a hand or a spoon so nobody is surprised.
Shoot the label
One clear photo of the ingredients and expiry date.
Try shades on different skin tones
For lipsticks, powders and hair colour.
lessons.try: Take four photos of one product: the texture, its size next to your hand, the label and the product in use.
lessons.try_pcm: Snap four photos of one product: the texture, the size near your hand, the label and the product as people dey use am.
checks: I have a texture photo
I have a photo that shows size
I photographed the label
My shade photos show real skin tones
lessons.quiz: Buyers say your small chops tray looks smaller than the picture. What should you add?
options: A photo with a hand or plate for scale
lessons.why: A hand or plate shows the real size, so the buyer knows what to expect.

lessons.title: Shelf life and stock rotation
lessons.intro: Food and beauty products don’t last forever. Selling your oldest stock first and making smaller batches stops you throwing money away.
lessons.intro_pcm: Food and beauty products no dey last forever. If you sell the old stock first and make small batches, you no go dey throw money away.
learn: What to do with stock near expiry
steps: Date everything
When you made or received it, and when it expires.
Put older stock in front
So it goes out first.
Make smaller batches
Only what you can sell well before it expires.
Check expiry every week
Bundle items early. Never sell anything expired.
lessons.try: Sort your stock today: oldest in front. Then list anything that expires in the next two months.
lessons.try_pcm: Arrange your stock today: the old ones for front. Then list anything wey go expire for the next two months.
checks: Every item has a date on it
My oldest stock is in front
My batches match what I sell
I check expiry dates every week
lessons.quiz: You have face cream that expires in four months and a fresh batch just in. Which goes out with the next order?
lessons.why: First in, first out keeps stock moving so nothing expires on your shelf.

lessons.title: Handling complaints about taste, allergies or skin reactions
lessons.intro: When a buyer says food tasted off or a cream irritated their skin, it is more serious than a wrong size. A calm, careful reply protects them and your shop.
lessons.intro_pcm: When buyer talk say food taste somehow or cream scratch their skin, e serious pass wrong size. Calm, careful reply go protect dem and your shop.
learn: When to point them to a pharmacist or doctor
Preventing repeats with allergy notes and patch tests
steps: Reply fast and kindly
Thank them and say you are looking into it.
Ask for details and photos
The product, the expiry date and what happened.
Ask them to stop using it
For a reaction, tell them to see a pharmacist or doctor.
Check the rest of that batch
Pause sales if anything looks wrong.
lessons.try: Write the calm reply you would send if a buyer said your soap made their skin itch. Save it as a quick reply.
lessons.try_pcm: Write the calm reply wey you go send if buyer talk say your soap make their body scratch. Save am as quick reply.
checks: I reply to health complaints fast
I ask for details and photos
I tell buyers to stop and see a pharmacist or doctor
I check the rest of the batch
lessons.quiz: A buyer says your cream gave them a rash. What should you do first?
options: Tell them it’s their skin, not your cream
Offer a discount on another jar
Apologise, ask them to stop using it and see a pharmacist or doctor
lessons.why: Their health comes first. Then check your batch so it doesn’t happen again.
